title: This Taiwanese Biotech Is Building a Nanorocket Inside the Human Body
summary: Oligonucleotide therapeutics are moving from sequence design to extrahepatic delivery. Intelligene is using EV and LNP platforms to target the lung and airways, testing whether RNA medicines can truly reach disease sites beyond the liver.
cover_image_alt: Intelligene uses EV and LNP RNA delivery platforms to target lung and airway diseases beyond the liver.
card_image_alt: Intelligene is building a nanorocket inside the human body for extrahepatic RNA delivery.
homepage_cover_image_alt: Intelligene is building a nanorocket inside the human body for the second half of oligonucleotide therapeutics.
